hunks.baseline: It was a method of regulating one’s energy by evening one’s breathing: drawing qi from outside the body, circulating it within, and accumulating it.
hunks.sol: It was a method of regulating one’s energy by steadying one’s breathing—drawing qi from outside the body, circulating it within, and accumulating it.

hunks.baseline: I had once heard that the human body contained more than three hundred and sixty acupoints, but based on what I could feel while circulating qi through the cultivation technique, there were even more than that.
hunks.sol: I had once heard that the human body contained more than three hundred and sixty acupoints, but based on what I could feel while using the cultivation technique, there were even more than that.

hunks.baseline: The ten years of internal energy I drew up from my dantian circulated through my body. If internal energy was a car, then the meridians were a highway. All I had to do was sit behind the wheel and press the accelerator.
hunks.sol: The ten years of internal energy I drew up from my dantian circulated through my body. If internal energy was a car, then the pathways between my acupoints were highways. All I had to do was sit behind the wheel and press the accelerator.

hunks.baseline: The internal energy raced along the straight and curving meridians throughout my body before returning to my dantian.
hunks.sol: The internal energy raced along those straight and curving pathways before returning to my dantian.

hunks.baseline: I took a long, deep breath. Then I felt it.
hunks.sol: I took a long, deep breath.
Then I felt it.

hunks.baseline: A second internal energy occupied my dantian like an enormous boulder that would not budge, no matter how hard I willed it to.
hunks.sol: Another mass of internal energy occupied my dantian like an enormous boulder that refused to budge, no matter how hard I willed it to.

hunks.baseline: It had been a mystery ever since I first circulated qi. An unidentified energy that had taken root like it owned the place.
hunks.sol: It had been a mystery ever since I first circulated my qi—an unidentified energy entrenched there as if it owned the place.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know where it had come from, how it had been formed, or why I couldn’t use it, but one thing was certain. This unidentified energy contained more power than the ten years of internal energy I possessed.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know where it had come from, how it had formed, or why I couldn’t use it, but one thing was certain. This unidentified energy contained even more power than my ten years of internal energy.

hunks.baseline: If I wanted to escape on my own, I had to fulfill the Logout Quest’s condition: reaching the First Rate realm.
hunks.sol: The situation had changed. If I wanted to escape on my own, I had to fulfill the Logout Quest’s condition: reaching the First Rate realm.

hunks.baseline: I also knew that I needed internal energy on the level of Lee Seogeun’s to become First Rate.
hunks.sol: And I knew now that becoming First Rate required about as much internal energy as Lee Seogeun had possessed.

hunks.baseline: The moment I sent it toward the unidentified energy, half anxious and half expectant, I realized something.
hunks.sol: The moment I guided it toward the unidentified energy, half anxious and half hopeful, I realized something.

hunks.baseline: Internal energy was, strictly speaking, qi itself—something without a physical form. And yet the instant the two energies touched, I felt powerful rejection and resistance.
hunks.sol: Internal energy was, strictly speaking, qi itself—something without physical form. Yet the instant the two energies touched, I felt a powerful rejection and resistance.
No. It was even pulling me in.

hunks.baseline: No. It was even pulling me in. At this rate, it was going to eat me alive.
hunks.sol: At this rate, it was going to devour me instead.

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly withdrew my internal energy and shook off the unidentified energy, which clung to me until the very end. At the same time, a System notification rang out.
hunks.sol: I hurriedly pulled my internal energy back and shook off the unidentified energy as it clung on to the bitter end. At the same time, a System notification rang out.

hunks.baseline: *Do I need to take a spirit pill, an elixir, something like that?*
hunks.sol: *Do I need to take a spirit pill or an elixir or something?*

hunks.baseline: I thought of Jin Wikyung. If I screwed up my courage and said, *Big brother, just give me one spirit pill,* I didn’t think he would refuse me outright.
hunks.sol: I thought of Jin Wikyung. If I bit the bullet and said, *Brother, just give me one spirit pill,* I didn’t think he would refuse me outright.

hunks.baseline: That worked out perfectly. There was something I wanted to ask him about.
hunks.sol: Perfect timing. There was something I wanted to ask him.

hunks.baseline: “It is beyond doubt. A few bones were broken, and there was some minor internal damage, but that level of injury could never—”
hunks.sol: “It is beyond doubt. A few bones were broken, and there was some minor internal damage, but injuries like that could never…”

hunks.baseline: “Are you sure? You swear that on the name of the Medicine King Hall Leader?”
hunks.sol: “Are you sure? Will you swear on your name as the Medicine King Hall Leader?”

hunks.baseline: “Then why are you talking down to me? I treated you with respect because you’re another Hall Leader, and now you think I’m a joke!”
hunks.sol: “Then that settles it. Why are you talking down to me? Huh? I treat you with respect because you’re another Hall Leader, and now you think I’m a joke?”

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t what I had imagined a family council would be like. I had pictured a quiet, orderly atmosphere where everyone exchanged opinions and searched for common ground…
hunks.sol: This wasn’t what I had imagined a family council would be like. I had pictured a quiet, orderly atmosphere where everyone exchanged opinions and tried to reach an agreement…

hunks.baseline: “You think every Hall Leader is your equal? You’re nothing but some quack doctor!”
hunks.sol: “You think all Hall Leaders are equal? You’re nothing but a mere physician!”

hunks.baseline: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to shove a large needle straight into his perineal acupoint!”
hunks.sol: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to ram a great big needle into your perineal acupoint.”

hunks.baseline: Two men in their forties or fifties, both with receding, M-shaped hairlines, were grabbing each other by the collars and shaking one another. Just watching them made my head hurt.
hunks.sol: Two men in their forties or fifties, both with receding M-shaped hairlines, were grabbing each other by the collars and shaking one another. Just watching them made my head hurt.

hunks.baseline: Maybe that was why most of the people there didn’t seem to notice me opening the door and taking my seat.
hunks.sol: Maybe that was why most of the people there didn’t seem to notice me open the door and take my seat.

hunks.baseline: —You came?
hunks.sol: —You’re here?

hunks.baseline: The voice sounded as if it had entered through my head rather than my ears. It was Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: The voice seemed to enter through my head rather than my ears.

hunks.sol: Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: I turned my head and met Jin Wikyung’s gaze from the seat of honor. He gave me a tired smile.
hunks.sol: I turned and met Jin Wikyung’s gaze from the seat of honor. He gave me a weary smile.

hunks.baseline: *You said it. Why did you call me to this madhouse, you old man?*
hunks.sol: *Exactly. So why did you call me into this madhouse?*

hunks.baseline: When I shot him a reproachful look, Jin Wikyung sent another message through Sound Transmission, his expression turning sheepish.
hunks.sol: I shot him a reproachful look. Looking slightly sheepish, Jin Wikyung sent another Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: —I couldn’t help it. The Elder Council demanded your attendance. In any case… you are involved in this matter.
hunks.sol: —I had no choice. The Elder Council demanded your attendance. Whatever else may be true… you are involved in this matter.

hunks.baseline: If there was one recent incident connected to me, it was the Mount Heng Sword Sect. And because of that incident, this thing called the Elder Council had summoned me.
hunks.sol: The only recent incident involving me was the one with the Mount Heng Sword Sect. And because of that incident, the Elder Council or whatever had summoned me.

hunks.baseline: There were four of them. Every one had a face covered in age spots and hair that had gone completely white.
hunks.sol: There were four of them. Every one had a face covered in age spots and a head of snow-white hair.

hunks.baseline: They watched the men with the M-shaped hairlines grab each other by the collars with cold eyes. Anyone could see it was a nursing home—or rather, the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: They watched the two balding men grapple with cold eyes. Anyone could see this was a nursing home—or rather, the Elder Council.

hunks.baseline: I had only just noticed that there were two seats of honor today. An old man was sitting to Jin Wikyung’s right, staring at me. His gaze made my face prickle.
hunks.sol: I had only just noticed that there were two seats of honor today. An old man sat to Jin Wikyung’s right, staring at me so intently that his gaze made my face prickle.

hunks.baseline: White hair, a white beard, and white eyebrows. He looked like an immortal who had stepped out of an old painting. His back was straight, his shoulders broad, and his skin taut enough to make his age seem meaningless.
hunks.sol: White hair, a white beard, and white eyebrows. He looked like an immortal who had stepped out of an old painting. His straight back, broad shoulders, and taut skin seemed to defy his age.

hunks.baseline: *But why is he staring at me so intently?*
hunks.sol: *But why is he staring at me like that?*

hunks.baseline: I gathered strength in my eyes and tried to glare back at the Head Elder…
hunks.sol: I put some force into my gaze and tried to glare back at the Head Elder…

hunks.baseline: Then I quietly looked away.
hunks.sol: Then quietly looked away.

hunks.baseline: Not because I thought I would lose if we locked eyes. It was respect for my elders. Respect for my elders. Really.
hunks.sol: Not because I thought I would lose if we locked eyes. It was out of respect for my elders. Respect for my elders. Really.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s Sound Transmission continued in the meantime.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s Sound Transmission continued.

hunks.baseline: —You may not know this because you lost your memory, but the Head Elder is your great-uncle and the most senior elder in the family. Be especially careful with your words and actions.
hunks.sol: —You may not know this because you lost your memory, but the Head Elder is your great-uncle and the most senior member of the family. Be especially careful with your words and actions.

hunks.baseline: *Maybe this place has relatives by marriage, distant cousins, and every kind of obscure uncle, too.*
hunks.sol: At this rate, the room might also contain an in-law’s distant cousin and every obscure uncle in the family tree.

hunks.baseline: —And… you must not be flustered by what happens from this point onward. Calmly tell them only the truth. Do you understand?
hunks.sol: —And… no matter what happens from this point onward, you must not lose your composure. Remain calm and tell them only the truth. Do you understand?

hunks.baseline: “This is a family council of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and we have gathered to discuss a grave matter. Since our witness has arrived, I intend to begin the interrogation.”
hunks.sol: “This is a family council of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and we have gathered to discuss a grave matter. Since the witness has arrived, I intend to begin the interrogation.”

hunks.baseline: The meeting hall had gone quiet without me noticing. With everyone’s attention focused on him, Jin Wikyung spoke.
hunks.sol: The meeting hall had fallen silent before I knew it. With everyone’s attention fixed on him, Jin Wikyung spoke.

hunks.baseline: “By the authority of the Lesser Family Head and current acting Family Head, I begin this interrogation. Third Young Master Jin Taekyung, step forward.”
hunks.sol: “By my authority as the Lesser Family Head and acting Family Head, I hereby begin this interrogation. Third Young Master Jin Taekyung, step forward.”

hunks.baseline: I barely managed to force the word out. My thoughts were a mess from the sudden question.
hunks.sol: I barely managed to get the word out. The sudden question had thrown my thoughts into chaos.

hunks.baseline: “Tell us the truth. If it turns out to be a lie…”
hunks.sol: “Tell us the truth. If your words are proven false…”

hunks.baseline: “I have nothing to do with Lee Seogeun’s poisoning.”
hunks.sol: “I had nothing to do with poisoning Lee Seogeun.”

hunks.baseline: My answer was as sharp as a blade. Jin Wikyung let out a sigh of relief.
hunks.sol: My answer was as sharp as a blade. Jin Wikyung let out a sigh tinged with relief.

hunks.baseline: —Keep doing exactly this.
hunks.sol: —Keep doing exactly that.

hunks.baseline: The interrogation proceeded quickly. They asked questions, and I answered them.
hunks.sol: The interrogation proceeded quickly. They asked questions, and I answered.

hunks.baseline: Just in case, I secretly opened my System Window to check. I was certain of it. None of my martial arts or abilities had anything to do with poison. I didn’t have any such Items, either.
hunks.sol: Just in case, I secretly opened my System Window and checked. I was certain. None of my martial arts or abilities had anything to do with poison. I didn’t possess any Items like that, either.

hunks.baseline: The problem was that, at some point, the atmosphere in the meeting hall began to grow strange.
hunks.sol: The problem was that, at some point, the atmosphere in the meeting hall began to take a strange turn.

hunks.baseline: “That is correct. Evidence. I mean evidence that would prove the Third Young Master’s innocence.”
hunks.sol: “That is correct. Evidence. Evidence that would prove the Third Young Master’s innocence.”

hunks.baseline: “Why do I have to prove it?”
hunks.sol: “Why do I have to prove that?”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t talk down to me.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t ‘what’ me.”

hunks.baseline: I’d been letting it slide, and these bastards thought they could wrap me up like a cloth?[^1]
hunks.sol: I’d let this go on long enough. Did these bastards think I was some damn wrapping cloth?[^1]

hunks.baseline: The strange thing was that everyone who had been pressing and interrogating me was doing something similar.
hunks.sol: And everyone who had been pressing and interrogating me was doing the same thing.

hunks.baseline: Nearly half the people in attendance were acting this way. It was getting difficult to pretend I hadn’t noticed.
hunks.sol: Nearly half the people in attendance were acting that way. It was getting difficult to pretend I hadn’t noticed.

hunks.baseline: The Elder Council and Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung and the Elder Council.

hunks.baseline: Even now, a power struggle was taking place between the senior members of the family and the Lesser Family Head who was young enough to be their grandson.
hunks.sol: Even now, a power struggle was unfolding between the senior members of the family and a Lesser Family Head young enough to be their grandson.

hunks.baseline: The oldest and fattest of them opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: The oldest and fattest among them spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Enough of this empty questioning. There is only one thing this old man wishes to ask. Where did this matter begin?”
hunks.sol: “Enough of these pointless questions. There is only one thing this old man wishes to ask. Where did this matter begin?”

hunks.baseline: “Who was it that dragged our family’s reputation through the mud with disorderly words and conduct?”
hunks.sol: “Who was it that dragged our family’s reputation through the mud with his dissolute words and conduct?”

hunks.baseline: “Then who was it that provoked the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s prized treasure and brought us to this crisis?”
hunks.sol: “Then who was it that laid hands on the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s treasured jewel and brought about the present crisis?”
